# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Currently, only the latest active branch (`main` and `dev`) are supported with security updates.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Security is a top priority for Plexi-ERP. If you discover a vulnerability, **do not open a public issue.**

Please report any security vulnerabilities privately by emailing **security@plascom.com**.

We will acknowledge your report within 48 hours and provide a timeline for the fix. Once the issue is resolved and deployed, we may publish a security advisory.
